subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should this auth doctor migration fix land now with the covered legacy shapes, or should maintainers require broader shipped-shape coverage or coordination first?
rationale: The code/proof supports the fix, but only an auth migration owner can accept the residual upgrade and sensitive-credential handling risk for shipped on-disk auth history.

options.title: Land After Auth Owner Pass
options.body: Accept the focused fix once an auth/security owner is comfortable with the covered legacy shapes and required CI remains green.

options.title: Add Broader Shipped-Shape Coverage
options.body: Require one more regression for an observed shipped auth-profile shape before merge if maintainers want lower upgrade risk.

options.title: Coordinate With Sibling Repair
options.body: Pause only if maintainers want this field-preservation fix bundled or rebased together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98245.

recommendation.title: Land After Auth Owner Pass
recommendation.body: Accept the focused fix once an auth/security owner is comfortable with the covered legacy shapes and required CI remains green.

likelyOwner.reason: The SQLite auth-profile migration originated in their merged PR and their history spans the touched persistence and doctor migration boundary.
